name: logbook
description: Git-native, multi-user, drift-aware session continuity for Claude Code.

ledger_backend.title: Ledger backend
ledger_backend.description: Backend used to store the ledger. 'orphan-branch' keeps ledger records on a dedicated git ref; 'custom-ref' targets a caller-supplied ref. Values are validated at the server boundary.

ledger_branch.title: Ledger branch
ledger_branch.description: Name of the git ref that holds the ledger when a git backend is selected.

disable_trailer.title: Disable commit trailer
disable_trailer.description: When enabled, the managed commit-msg hook does not append the Thread-Id trailer to commit messages.

disable_bash_guard.title: Disable Bash guard prompts
disable_bash_guard.description: When enabled, the PreToolUse guard never prompts about a Bash command that names the ledger store. Writes into a ledger root through Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit stay denied regardless of this setting.
